value: Toto barked at a kitten.
unit: Toto lived on a Kansas farm with Dorothy, bringing her joy amidst grey surroundings. When a cyclone struck the farm, Toto hid under the bed, causing Dorothy to stay behind to grab him, which resulted in them both being carried away inside the house to the Land of Oz. During their travel along the yellow brick road to the Emerald City, Toto accompanied Dorothy, meeting the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion. He bravely ran at a roaring Lion to protect Dorothy, prompting her to slap the beast and discover it was a coward. He accidentally fell asleep in a deadly poppy field and was carried out by the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, later waking up to chase the Queen of the Mice's subjects until restrained by the Tin Woodman. Upon reaching the Emerald City, he wore locked green spectacles and received a green ribbon. When the Cowardly Lion roared in Oz's throne room, Toto accidentally knocked over a screen, exposing the Great Wizard as an ordinary little man. He caused Dorothy to miss her balloon ride back to Kansas when he ran into a crowd to bark at a kitten. Continuing with Dorothy to the Land of the South, he survived encounters with fighting trees and was transported by Winged Monkeys. Eventually, he returned safely to Kansas when Dorothy activated her Silver Shoes, immediately running off to bark at Uncle Henry's barnyard.
